local_processing.data_access: OpenML mirror dataset 41150 through an exact local cache
local_processing.scientific_claim_boundary: MiniBooNE dataset 41150 and the registered ML-CRA protocols only

decision_basis: UCI is the source named by the OpenML record and currently identifies creator DOI and CC BY 4.0
the OpenML record independently labels its mirror CC0 but provides no examined proof that the uploader controlled all rights needed for a CC0 waiver
CC0 applies only to the extent the affirmer owns the relevant rights and disclaims clearance of third party rights
CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adaptation when attribution marking and change indication conditions are satisfied
license_metadata_conflict.practical_consequence: The conflict is controlled for project release engineering without claiming a court determination; raw data remains excluded and every included MiniBooNE-derived artifact requires attribution and provenance marking.

required_attribution.creator: Byron Roe
required_attribution.mirror_notice: ML-CRA accessed the OpenML mirror dataset 41150; OpenML metadata identifies UCI as the original source.
required_attribution.change_notice: OpenML represents 130064 data rows as an ARFF classification dataset with target signal and ParticleID_0 through ParticleID_49; ML-CRA maps False/True to 0/1 and publishes only protocols, derived model-evaluation evidence and bounded conclusions, not the raw dataset.
required_attribution.openml_platform_citation: Vanschoren, J., van Rijn, J. N., Bischl, B., and Torgo, L. (2013). OpenML: Networked Science in Machine Learning. SIGKDD Explorations 15(2). https://doi.org/10.1145/2641190.2641198.
required_attribution.endorsement_disclaimer: Attribution must not imply endorsement by Byron Roe, UCI, MiniBooNE, OpenML or Creative Commons.
